row.team_price_text: Group: $135+/mo billed annually (1 standard seat), +$50/mo per additional clinician
row.evidence: Healthie documents no SCIM; its SSO article says SSO is provided "as part of our web white-label" via OAuth, with accounts matched by email the first time a user signs in.
row.notes: No SCIM found on the pricing page, help centre (search: scim, provisioning, saml, okta), API docs or API reference. SSO is custom OAuth/OIDC set up by Healthie (14 business days, possible extra fee) and is part of the web white-label on the Enterprise plan; no SAML. Self-serve plans are flat per-practice prices (Core $18, Essentials $45, Plus $115, Group $135+/mo billed annually); Group is the first plan with team members and adds $50/mo per clinician, so per-user fields are null. Enterprise (5 standard + 5 support seats base) is Contact Sales. The GraphQL API, which can create, update and delete organization members (providers), is an optional paid add-on on Enterprise, so api_tax is true; the audit-log API is Enterprise-only. Not in the Okta OIN.
